calls.head: Penalties could cost the Islanders
calls.body: The Devils’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Islanders’ kill is one of the worst. Every trip to the box hurts the Islanders more than most.

calls.head: Strength in numbers for the Islanders
calls.body: The Islanders roll four lines, but the Devils lean on their top six. The Islanders are near the top of the league for depth, and New Jersey is one of the worst. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Islanders.

surprises.head: A shutout for Ilya Sorokin
surprises.body: Sorokin stopped all 37 shots, worth 3.7 expected goals. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 300 starts. Most starters don’t get one a season.

surprises.head: The Islanders brought the hits
surprises.body: The Islanders’ hit score in the close stretches of the game was 171, against their usual 94 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 50 games.

story.head: Sorokin stops all 37 to blank the Devils
paras: An ugly night for the Devils. Simon Holmström and Brayden Schenn scored a minute and a half apart early in the second to put the Islanders up 2-0. Bo Horvat made it 3-0 on the power play midway through the period. The third was all Islanders: Victor Eklund, in his third NHL game, scored his first NHL goal, set up by Calum Ritchie, Ondřej Palát scored, and Casey Cizikas scored shorthanded to make it 6-0.
The chances were closer than the score. Ilya Sorokin turned aside all 37 shots for the Islanders, and Nico Daws allowed six goals on 32 shots.
The Islanders killed all five Devils power plays. The Isles moved to 1-1-0 and climbed out of last place in the NHL, while the Devils fell to 1-1-0, slipping out of first in the NHL.

items.text: The Devils’ Timo Meier played his 700th NHL game.
The Islanders won their home opener and have beaten the Devils six straight times, going back to the 2024-25 season.
The Islanders won without Mathew Barzal. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Blue Jackets and the Ducks were missing more at the time.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
